meta.promptText: Mujhe India mein 3000 rupees ke andar running shoes kharidne hain. Konse lene chahiye?

attemptsLog.error: DataForSEO gemini task error 40102: No Search Results.

response.text:
Agar aapka budget **₹3,000 ke andar** hai, toh India mein kayi badiya brands ke running shoes mil jaate hain jo daily running, walking aur gym ke liye best hain.

Yahan kuch top options hain:

Yeh adidas Galaxy 7 shoes **Cloudfoam midsole** ke sath aate hain jo running ke dauran shandar cushioning aur comfort dete hain.

Puma ka yeh Skyrocket Lite model **ultra-lightweight PUMALITE cushioning** aur breathable mesh upper ke sath aata hai, jo 5K runs ke liye perfect hai.

ASICS JOLT 4 mein **EVA midsole aur OrthoLite sockliner** milta hai, jo ghutnon (knees) par dabav kam karne aur long-lasting comfort ke liye jaana jaata hai.

Decathlon ke ye Jogflow 190.1 shoes regular training aur 20km tak weekly running ke liye **exceptional cushioning aur grip** provide karte hain.

Yeh adidas Zapid budget-friendly option hai jo **superior traction aur breathability** ke sath daily wear aur running dono ke liye accha choice hai.

Skyrocket Lite 2 mein updated **SOFTFOAM+ plush feel** aur FIT PLUS lacing system hai josecure grip aur road running mein max comfort deta hai.
